answers.goal: I would love to work in creative film development on the story side for either TV shows, live action movies, but more specifically, an animation studio. I am still discovering all the incredible roles within the industry, and where I fall into everything. My goal can be narrowed down to simply sharing stories and having my viewpoints/visions represented in the content we consume.
answers.drew: I have a passion for telling stories, and entertainment has so many different avenues for doing exactly this. Whether it is being on the creative development side of filmmaking or finding ways to bring such stories to life through consumer products, the entertainment industry is a space for fueling the imagination/creativity that shaped who I am today.
answers.seeking: I am looking to connect with people who are passionate, creative, kind, and excited to meet others. I am hoping to make new friends and find people who share a love for entertainment as much as I do!
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration are my friends Cece and Zen. They both beat very rare/aggressive forms of cancer, and have used their challenge to inspire good in the world. I love them very much.
